files.matrix.sop:
# ui.help as a matrix: what each area of the app can do is the knowledge base (kb.sop, generated by scripts/gen-ui-kb.mjs from the manifests and the canonical examples
# of the patterns), and "what can you do in the map?" is a question the library answers by looking the area up. There is very little state, and the library adds
# little to this world: the choice of the examples to show (a rotation over a world's patterns, the closest examples to a sentence, edit distance) stays in ops.mjs.
#   ui.help.state   one, once the help was used: rest = the state ops.mjs keeps as JSON (the rotation cursor of each world, the last help, the last sentence that was not
#                   understood). The world is passive: the dialog layer writes `lastUnparsed` after a failed sentence and that is not a step of the turn; only a help
#                   request is, so "undo that" after "more examples" puts the rotation back.

@hp.seq core.sequence key=core.seq

@hp.k.rest core.slot of=ui.help.state key=rest kind=blob required=true
